page.notes: The facing page on the right is cut off by the scan edge; only the first letters of its lines are visible, so its fragments are given as far as they can be read. Doubtful readings: "fasti[?]" (the word is broken by a damaged glyph in the scan). "Fratribꝰ" is printed with a superscript ꝰ. Long s has been written as s throughout. Italic passages are marked with <i>. The text runs on from the previous page and ends with "Or-bem" at the foot of the column.
